changes: Removed the analysis (AnalysisInfo), LFE, energy mask, signalling, tonality, input clipping and error query requests and the DRED decode entry point.
celt_encoder_init() takes no sampling rate (48 kHz only); celt_preemphasis() is private to the encoder.
No custom signalling, decoder complexity (deep PLC only) or error flag; the ctl keeps start/end band, channels, mode, final range and reset.
celt_decode_with_ec_dred() is celt_decode_with_ec(); the QEXT payload remnant and the neural PLC frame types are removed.
Fixed to 48 kHz input (no upsampling) without custom signalling, LFE, surround energy mask or tonality analysis input; 16-bit input depth and enabled phase inversion are constants.
Pre-emphasis keeps only the fixed-point path; dynalloc, trim, VBR and prefilter analysis lose their analysis and surround arguments; the unused pitch change estimate is removed.
The ctl drops the LSB depth, phase inversion, signalling, analysis, LFE and energy mask requests; coarse energy quantization is called without the LFE flag.
opus_fft_c() and opus_ifft_c() (tonality analysis only) removed; the MDCT calls opus_fft_impl().
Declarations of the removed FFT entry points and of the custom-mode FFT allocator removed.
ec_laplace_encode_p0() and ec_laplace_decode_p0() (DRED only) removed.
ec_laplace_encode_p0() and ec_laplace_decode_p0() (DRED only) removed.
celt_cos_norm32() (unused) removed.
celt_cos_norm32() (unused) removed.
quant_coarse_energy() loses the LFE argument (LFE coding is not supported).
quant_coarse_energy() loses the LFE argument (LFE coding is not supported).
Declares only the implemented API: no create/destroy (no heap), float or 24-bit entry points, DRED, soft clipping, repacketizer, packet padding or opus_decoder_get_nb_samples().
The encoder documentation describes the voice profile.
silk_scale_vector32_Q26_lshift_18() (unused) removed.
silk_DecControlStruct loses prevPitchLag and enable_deep_plc; silk_EncControlStruct loses reducedDependency.
No deep PLC flag and no previous pitch lag export.
One frame per call (20 ms, or 10 ms for the prefill): multi-frame LBRR flags, per-block bit shaping and the in-packet bit balance are removed.
No reduced-dependency mode.
silk_scale_vector32_Q26_lshift_18() (unused) removed.
silk_PLC_struct loses enable_deep_plc.
opus_packet_parse() implements parsing without self-delimited framing, padding output or packet offset (multistream and extensions only); encode_size() removed.
Requests limited to reset, gain and final range; the complexity (deep PLC), bandwidth, sample rate, pitch, last packet duration, phase inversion and extension requests are removed.
No create/destroy, opus_decode24(), DRED or packet extension parsing; opus_decode_native() is private.
Reduced to the voice profile: 48 kHz, VOIP, one 20 ms VBR frame per packet, 16-bit input. Packets are bit-identical to upstream for these settings.

Removed: multi-frame repacketizing, CBR padding, the AUDIO and restricted applications, forced mode, bandwidth and channels, signal and voice ratio hints, LFE, surround masking, tonality analysis, float and 24-bit input, create/destroy.
Requests: bitrate, complexity, in-band FEC (0 or 1), packet loss, DTX, VBR constraint, lookahead, final range and reset.
Keeps the mode constants and align(); repacketizer, extension, multistream and private encoder/decoder declarations removed.
